To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
family-friendly management is positively related to the performance effects of workforce commitment, but not to labour turnover and absentee rates, nor to organizational legitimacy.

family-friendly management is associated with higher levels of workforce commitment and higher productivity, but not with lower labour turnover and absentee levels; the effects of family-friendly management on commitment are stronger in organizations that also use high involvement management; family-friendly management does not affect organizational legitimacy.
family-friendly management has a positive effect on productivity and quality, and the effect of family-friendly management on productivity is stronger in organizations that are high commitment.
